note: Note: if you are stacking chest rewards probably this feature won't work properly.
description1: Auto-kick will listen to the events on your selected accounts and run kicking process when it detects the match has ended.
description2: Also, remember kicking is intelligent. There's no need of enabling two autokick's on your accounts if they are in the same party, both of your accounts will get kicked/leave (and claim rewards if you had auto-claim active) depending on the case.

logfile.description: Watch FortniteGame.log for End Of Match, then kick, claim, or transfer mats for the account in that instance.
